## [1.0.4] - 2026-08-05

### Fixed

- Widened the supported `@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent` peer dependency range to `>=0.80.3 <1`, preventing installation conflicts with pi 0.81 and newer. ([#4](https://github.com/anthod0/pi-lab/issues/4))
